videos.title: The full B4 tour: every NinjaTrader 8 tool, explained
videos.summary: Seven and a half minutes: the B4 chart (footprint, volume profile, key levels, signal markers), B4 Indicator Pro, B4 Ichimoku, the Order Flow Tape, DOM and Scanner, B4 CoPilot Pro, then two NQ longs from signal to exit.
videos.note: Tour images are illustrations, not live trading results. The two trades are simulated (NinjaTrader Sim account). Selected trades; the session also had losing trades.

videos.title: B4 for NinjaTrader 8: the tools tour and one ES trade
videos.summary: Footprint bars, volume profile and key levels, the Tape that reads the order flow out loud, B4 levels on the DOM ladder, and B4 CoPilot Pro managing one ES short from entry to exit.
videos.note: Simulated (NinjaTrader Sim account). One trade chosen from a longer session; not typical of every trade.

videos.title: The B4 Tape reads every print, out loud
videos.summary: B4 Order Flow's Tape: the situation line, every print with its size and state, big prints, levels beside the prints, an event timeline, and Voice + Teach.
videos.note: Recorded on a NinjaTrader Sim account. B4 Order Flow is on pre-sale and ships with B4 V4.

videos.title: Two NQ longs, from the B4 signal to the exit
videos.summary: The B4 chart marks the setup, B4 CoPilot Pro enters with the stop and two targets attached, the Tape reads the order flow, and a trailing stop takes the last contracts.
videos.note: Simulated (NinjaTrader Sim account). Selected trades; the session also had losing trades.
